meta.title: fly.ai ambassadors: represent fly.ai in your language
meta.description: A few fly.ai ambassadors, one per language. A blue check, a soulbound badge, the top referral tier from day one, 50 XP a day and early access. Paid only on real results.

head.title: Represent fly.ai in your language
head.lede: We're picking a few ambassadors, one per language: Chinese, Korean, Turkish, Spanish and more. You help people in your community get started with Trader Flies, and you earn from the real users you bring.

get.title: What ambassadors get
get.check: Blue check next to your name across fly.ai, and the soulbound Ambassador badge on chain.
get.tier: Top referral tier from day one: 1.25% of your referrals' Fly Wallet profits and Fly Desk payouts, and half off your own fee, without needing 50 referrals.
get.xp: 50 XP a day while you hold the badge, on top of everything else. XP counts toward the New Year drop.
get.discord: Ambassador role and a private channel with the team on Discord.
get.early: Early access to new features, presets and chains before everyone else, and the first creator slots when the launchpad opens.

rules.title: How it works
rules.few: Few and picked by hand. 3 to 5 people, ideally one per language. Applying doesn't guarantee a place.
rules.results: Paid only on results. No salary and no new tokens: you earn through referrals, from fly.ai's fees on real users who deposit and stay. Bring no one and it costs nothing.
rules.new: New people only. Your link works for new accounts, like every referral link.
rules.fair: Fair play. No price promises, no cold DMs, no farming accounts. Inactive for 60 days, and the badge and role go back.
rules.review: Monthly check-in with the team: who you brought, what's working, what you need.

list.title: Current ambassadors
list.none: No ambassadors yet. Be one of the first.
